title: Fix application not opening / deployment error

requirements.text: Audit and fix any compilation or runtime errors in `backend/main.mo` and `backend/migration.mo` that are preventing the canister from deploying successfully. Ensure all Motoko syntax is valid, all imported modules resolve correctly, all stable variable declarations are compatible, and the actor compiles without errors so the canister can be initialized and upgraded.
acceptanceCriteria: The backend canister compiles without any Motoko type or syntax errors.
The canister deploys successfully and the init/postupgrade hooks run without trapping.
Both admin seed accounts (genmitra/12345678 and admin/Admin@1234) and the user seed (genmitra/1234) are present in stable storage after deploy.
All demo/seeded products are present in stable storage after deploy.

requirements.text: Audit and fix all frontend TypeScript compilation errors in the React application that could prevent the frontend bundle from building or the app from loading in the browser. Check `frontend/src/App.tsx`, all page components, hooks, and utility files for type errors, missing imports, undefined variables, or broken module references. Ensure the frontend builds and renders without a blank screen or uncaught JavaScript errors on initial load.
acceptanceCriteria: The frontend TypeScript build completes without compilation errors.
The application renders its homepage without a blank screen or console errors that block rendering.
Navigation between pages works without runtime crashes.
The admin route guard correctly redirects unauthenticated users to the login page without triggering Internet Identity.

requirements.text: Verify and fix the canister configuration (`dfx.json` or equivalent) to ensure both the frontend and backend canisters are correctly specified, the frontend asset canister points to the correct build output directory, and the backend canister entry point resolves to `backend/main.mo`. Ensure the full-stack deployment pipeline (backend compile → frontend build → asset upload) completes without errors.
acceptanceCriteria: Running the deployment pipeline produces no configuration or path resolution errors.
The frontend canister serves the built React app at the root URL.
The backend canister is reachable and responds to query/update calls.
The deployed app opens correctly in a browser without a blank or error screen.

constraints: Do not change the single-actor backend architecture — all Motoko logic must remain in backend/main.mo.
Do not edit any files listed in frontend.immutablePaths.
Preserve all existing features and data structures; only fix errors preventing deployment and loading.
nonGoals: Adding new features or redesigning UI components.
Changing authentication logic beyond what is needed to fix the deployment error.
Migrating to a different tech stack or backend language.
